verdict.rationale: Jira is an issue-tracking and project-management product, not a coding agent or execution environment, so having an agent detect and install toolchains and dependencies is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira shipping this capability: Rovo AI is described only for automations, task breakdown and trend analysis, and the MCP server is an integration surface, not an environment-provisioning agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
